title: Build graphene atomic models
action: Generate initial atomic coordinates for pristine graphene sheets (zigzag and armchair orientations, ~50 nm × 50 nm) and for bicrystalline graphene sheets containing symmetric tilt grain boundaries (misorientation angles 5.7° and 27.8°, zigzag-oriented) with the GB line centered.
description: Create the atomic structures that will be equilibrated and indented. The agent must construct the grain boundaries according to standard crystallographic methods.

title: Equilibrate samples
action: Equilibrate each atomic structure at 300 K using the AIREBO potential with a 1.0 fs timestep: first an NPT ensemble for 20 ps, then an NVT ensemble for 10 ps.
description: Bring all graphene variants to thermal equilibrium before loading, as performed in the paper's MD protocol.

title: Cylindrical nanoindentation simulations and strength extraction
action: For each equilibrated sample, perform virtual cylindrical nanoindentation: apply a rigid cylindrical indenter (radius 50 Å, force constant 10 eV/Å³) moving downward at 0.02 Å/ps, with clamped edges and periodic boundary along the indenter axis. Run pristine zigzag, pristine armchair, GB_5.7° (indenter centered on GB line, S=0, and at lateral offsets S=40 Å and S=80 Å), and GB_27.8° (S=0). Additionally, for the GB_5.7° sample, perform two simulations with angular misalignment of the indenter relative to the GB line: (i) in-plane misalignment θ_z = 10° (indenter axis rotated in the plane of the sheet) and (ii) out-of-plane misalignment θ_x = 2° (indenter axis tilted out of the sheet plane), with no periodic boundary along the indenter axis (as in the paper for angular misalignment) and clamped edges; indenter parameters unchanged. For each run, record the maximum force (failure force) from the force–displacement curve and convert it to estimated uniaxial tensile strength using the maximum virial stress at fracture, as described in the paper. Output a single CSV file with results for all cases.
description: Estimated tensile strengths and failure forces for pristine and polycrystalline graphene under cylindrical nanoindentation, including offset and angular misalignment tests. This file must be produced by the MD workflow and is the sole scored artifact.
output_schema: CSV with columns: case (string, e.g., pristine_zigzag, pristine_armchair, GB_5.7deg, GB_27.8deg, GB_5.7deg_offset40, GB_5.7deg_offset80, GB_5.7deg_inplane10deg, GB_5.7deg_outplane2deg), tilt_angle (degrees, NaN for pristine), offset_S (Å, NaN if not offset test), failure_force (nN), estimated_strength (GPa).
